US Bolsters Middle East Military Presence Amid Iran Tensions

The United States is reportedly preparing to significantly increase its military presence in the Middle East, with plans to deploy an additional 10,000 troops and potentially a carrier strike group. This buildup comes as President Trump is said to be considering strikes against Iran. One report indicates a total of 20,000 troops and 150 fighter jets are being readied for the region.
